hero.title: A student residence that feels like home
hero.lede: A private residence for female students in the heart of Avcılar — professionally managed, secure around the clock, and a short walk from the Metrobüs that reaches five university campuses in under half an hour.
hero.imageAlt: The entrance and common seating area at Kıvanç Kız Yurdu

rooms.title: Hotel-style rooms, four ways to share
rooms.lede: 45 rooms across the building, in four sizes. Every one of them is hotel-style — its own bathroom and WC inside the room, a TV, a mini fridge and a brand-new study set. What changes between them is how many people share, and what that does to the monthly rate.
rooms.disclaimer: Campaign rates for the new term, per person. The term price covers 10 months and can be paid as a deposit plus instalments — the full breakdown is on the rooms page.

about.title: Built for students. Answerable to parents.
about.p1: Most of our residents move to Istanbul from another city, and for their families that first year is a leap of faith. We built Kıvanç around that reality: one properly staffed building, clear rules, transparent pricing, and someone reachable whenever a parent needs an answer.
about.p2: We're not a large chain. The residence is run day to day by the same family that has owned it since 2013, which is why the standards hold.

v1.title: Safety comes first
v1.desc: Controlled entry, 24/7 camera recording and staff on site at every hour — and entries and exits reported to the family as they happen.

v2.title: We answer in your language
v2.desc: Turkish and English support today, with Arabic-speaking staff for international students.

v3.title: Transparent pricing
v3.desc: One monthly figure covering bills, cleaning, laundry and meals. No surprises mid-year.

v4.title: A real community
v4.desc: Study groups, shared meals and events that make a new city feel smaller.

faq.title: Before you apply
faq.lede: If your question isn't here, call or message us — we answer in Turkish and English, seven days a week.

1.q: How do I apply for a room?
1.a: Send us the form at the bottom of this page or message us on WhatsApp with your name, university and preferred room type. We'll confirm availability, invite you for a visit, and hold the room with a deposit once you decide.

2.a: The standard contract runs for the academic year, from September to June. Summer stays and shorter terms are available on request, subject to availability.

3.q: What does the monthly price include?
3.a: Rent, all utilities, fibre internet, weekly room cleaning, use of the laundry, hot water around the clock, 24/7 security, and breakfast every morning. There is no separate bill at the end of the month.

4.q: Can parents visit, and what are the security rules?
4.a: Families are welcome during visiting hours and are received in the ground-floor lounge. Entry to the residence floors is by keycard and limited to residents and staff. Every entrance is recorded around the clock, reception is staffed 24 hours a day, and each student's entry and exit can be sent straight to her family on WhatsApp or Telegram.

5.a: Monthly by bank transfer, or in instalments agreed at signing. We issue a receipt for every payment and never ask for cash without documentation.

6.a: Yes. The building closes at 23:00 on weekdays and at midnight at weekends. A student who needs to return later, or to stay out overnight, arranges it with the resident manager in advance and her family is informed.

istanbul-kiz-yurdu.title: Girls' Dormitory in Istanbul | Kıvanç Kız Yurdu
istanbul-kiz-yurdu.description: A private female-only residence in Avcılar: 45 rooms, private bathrooms, 24/7 security and camera recording, breakfast included.
istanbul-kiz-yurdu.lede: Kıvanç Kız Yurdu is a private residence in Avcılar, Istanbul, for female students only. The building holds 45 rooms in four sizes; every one has its own bathroom and WC, a television, a mini fridge and a brand-new study set.

p: The residence occupies a single building on Kirazlı Caddesi in Cihangir Mahallesi. Rooms come as singles, doubles, triples and quads; what changes between them is how many people share, and what that does to the monthly rate. The fittings are the same in every room type.
A manager lives in the building. When something goes wrong you reach a person who knows the student by name, not a call centre in another city.

You pay one monthly figure: rent, utilities, fibre internet, weekly room cleaning, the laundry, hot water around the clock and breakfast every morning are all inside it. There is no separate bill at the end of the month.
If you cannot visit in person, we will show you the rooms live over a video call.

istanbul-ogrenci-yurdu.title: Student Residence in Istanbul | Kıvanç Kız Yurdu
istanbul-ogrenci-yurdu.description: A student residence in Avcılar: four room types from ₺15,000 a month, payment by instalments, breakfast and utilities included.
istanbul-ogrenci-yurdu.lede: Kıvanç Kız Yurdu houses female students in Avcılar for the academic year. The standard contract runs September to June, and payment is spread over instalments.

p: When you compare student residences, the real question is how much of the monthly figure it actually covers. Here you pay one amount, and utilities, internet, cleaning, laundry, hot water and breakfast are inside it. Nothing arrives separately at the end of the month.
Every room is hotel-style: the bathroom and WC are inside the room, so there is no queue in a corridor. Each room has a television, a mini fridge and a new study desk.
The standard contract covers the September to June academic year. Summer stays and shorter stays are considered subject to availability.
Payment is a deposit plus instalments, and a receipt is issued for every payment. Cash is never requested without a document.

istanbul-kiz-ogrenci-yurdu.title: Female Student Residence in Istanbul | Kıvanç Kız Yurdu
istanbul-kiz-ogrenci-yurdu.description: A residence for female students only. Card entry, 24/7 camera recording, entry and exit notifications, and management living on site.
istanbul-kiz-ogrenci-yurdu.lede: Kıvanç Kız Yurdu takes female students only. The building is not mixed, entry to the dormitory floors is by card, and visitors are received in the ground-floor lounge.

p: The hardest part of sending a student to Istanbul from another city is not being able to see what is happening. Every entry and exit is logged, and families who want them receive those notifications over WhatsApp.
A manager lives in the building, and families are welcome during visiting hours.
The building closes at 23:00 on weeknights and 24:00 at weekends. A student who needs to return later arranges it with the manager in advance.
Weekly room cleaning and daily upkeep of the common areas are included in the monthly rate.

guvenli-kiz-yurdu-istanbul.title: Secure Girls' Residence in Istanbul | Kıvanç Kız Yurdu
guvenli-kiz-yurdu-istanbul.description: Staffed reception around the clock, card entry, uninterrupted camera recording in all common areas, and entry and exit notifications to families.
guvenli-kiz-yurdu-istanbul.lede: Security is the easiest thing to write in a residence brochure and the hardest to demonstrate. What follows is what is actually in place at Kıvanç Kız Yurdu.

p: Reception is staffed day and night, and every entrance has card access. There is no way onto the dormitory floors without a card.
All common areas and entrances are recorded continuously through the day, and the recordings are retained.
Families are received in the ground-floor lounge during visiting hours. Visitors do not go up to the dormitory floors.
The building closes at 23:00 on weeknights and 24:00 at weekends.

universitelere-yakin-kiz-yurdu.title: Girls' Residence Near Universities, Istanbul | Kıvanç
universitelere-yakin-kiz-yurdu.description: From Avcılar by Metrobüs: Gelişim 5 min, Beykent 10 min, Aydın 15 min, Arel 20 min, Biruni 30 min. The stop is a short walk away.
universitelere-yakin-kiz-yurdu.h1: Girls' Residence Near Universities in Istanbul
universitelere-yakin-kiz-yurdu.lede: Avcılar's advantage is the Metrobüs line. You walk to the stop from the residence and reach most of Istanbul's private university campuses without changing.

p: The time spent on the road every morning matters as much as the monthly rate. The times below are approximate, over the Metrobüs line, in normal traffic.
More than half an hour each way to make a first lecture adds up over an academic year.
The Metrobüs, bus and minibus lines are all a short walk from the building.
You can check the times yourself: the address is below and marked on the map.

kiz-yurdu-fiyatlari.lede: The monthly rates below are per person and vary only by how many students share the room. The fittings are the same in every room type.

p: The only difference between the rooms is how many people are in them. The private bathroom, the television, the mini fridge and the study set are in every room type; the quad is not less well equipped because it costs less.
Payment is a deposit plus instalments, and a receipt is issued for every payment.

close.h: What the rate does not cover
p: The monthly figure covers rent, utilities, internet, weekly cleaning, the laundry, hot water, security and breakfast.
Lunch and dinner are not included in the monthly rate.
